spl_product_data_elements: AQUACETIC-30 Cleaning Solution for Hemodialysis Machines CITRIC ACID MONOHYDRATE ANHYDROUS CITRIC ACID WATER
spl_unclassified_section: INDUSTRIAL VINEGAR FOR THE CLEANING OF HEMODIALYSIS MACHINES
purpose: This product is used to descale and clean hemodialysis machines.
indications_and_usage: For use with 3-pump hemodialysis machines only, using purified water.
warnings: Avoid contact with skin and eyes. Do not mix with hypochlorite, or with hydrogen peroxide, or in general with any chemical base.
do_not_use: Do not mix with hypochlorite, or with hydrogen peroxide, or in general with any chemical base.
when_using: Take appropriate security measures (protective clothing, glasses, masks).
stop_use: If you do not use the entire contents, discard the excess.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: This product is used to descale and clean hemodialysis machines.
storage_and_handling: Store at room temperature. Keep container tightly closed when not in use.
